financings_after_balance_sheet.what: PIPE financing of 25,000,000 shares at $3.21 per share; gross proceeds (net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The gross proceeds to the Company from the PIPE are $80.3 million, before deducting fees to the placement agents and other offering expenses payable by the Company. This transaction closed on November 4, 2022.
